question: When was Radio broadcasting started in India by the Radio Club Bombay?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1923**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Radio broadcasting in India was initiated by the **Radio Club of Bombay** in **June 1923**. This marked the very beginning of radio as a medium for mass communication in the country.
 
• Following the success of the Bombay initiative, the **Calcutta Radio Club** was established in **November 1923**, further expanding the reach of experimental broadcasting.
 
• During its initial years, radio broadcasting was a **private enterprise**, operated by hobbyists and enthusiasts before any formalized government structure was established.
 
• In **1927**, a private entity called the **Indian Broadcasting Company (IBC)** was authorized to operate two radio stations: one in **Bombay** (launched on July 23, 1927) and another in **Calcutta** (launched on August 26, 1927).
